hero.title: Find Your Behavioral Twin
hero.subtitle: Record your daily activities, discover people who live just like you, and become pen pals with your "another me".

features.title: How It Works
features.subtitle: Three simple steps to find your behavioral match

step1.title: Log Daily Activities
step1.description: Select tags for your daily activities — reading, coding, cooking, and more. Add notes to share the details.

step2.title: Build Your Profile
step2.description: After 20 records, our algorithm analyzes your behavioral patterns and finds people with similar lifestyles.

step3.title: Connect with Your Twin
step3.description: Send pen pal requests to your matches. Once accepted, exchange emails and forge a unique connection.

t1.text: I found someone who reads the same books, codes in the same languages, and meditates every morning just like me. It's uncanny!
t1.author: Sarah K.

t2.text: My pen pal and I have been writing for months. We live on different continents but share the same daily rhythm.
t2.author: Li Wei

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: We use cosine similarity on your activity frequency vectors to find people with the most similar behavioral patterns.
faq.q2: What happens after I send a pen pal request?
faq.a2: If the other person accepts, you'll both receive each other's email addresses to start your correspondence.
faq.q3: Can I cancel my premium subscription?
faq.a3: Yes, you can cancel anytime. Your premium features remain active until the end of the billing period.
